title: The Canon of Inception
summary: A canon on the first instant of a thing and on bringing a new force into being at the heart of the field.

title: Treatise of the Spoken Fiat
summary: A treatise on speaking a decree with the whole will and making it so within the limits of the user's power.

title: Manual of the Living Spring
summary: A manual on opening a spring of qi that heals flows outward in floods and returns breath to the fallen.

title: The Planner's Canon
summary: A canon on making a thing in thought first and then in qi until the plan stands complete in the field.

title: Reckoning of the Woven Loom
summary: A reckoning of weaving strands of new qi on a loom of will into shrouds bindings and healing cloth.

title: Canon of the Anvil and Hammer
summary: A canon on making a great anvil of qi under the foe and bringing the hammer of the user's will down on it.
